title: CRF450R Motocross
description: Representing Honda's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Honda CRF450R Motocross is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 450cc powerplant pumps out 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
